objective: Locked four-A100 mechanics check for full projected-key address diagonal-sign binding in RWKV-MS.

authorization_basis.prior_sign_failure: Folded 32-D addresses separated only 0.74-0.77 donor rows; full projected keys retain the 64-D address before coding.

architecture.write: bind RWKV v with a hard detached diagonal +/-1 code from the full projected slot key before scan; use the committed argmax slot address
architecture.read: unbind each RWKV slot read with that slot's full projected key code before route aggregation and HRM readout
architecture.commutation: diagonal signs commute with RWKV value-axis keep/erase/correction updates

training.open_fit_rows_only: one inherited open-fit schedule row per rank
training.projection: deterministic rectangular QR projections, seed 115 plus layer index

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize a separately signed eight-update causal run with full-key codes frozen.
stopping_rule.fail: Retire diagonal-sign binding; do not tune gain, batch size, learning rate, or duration.
stopping_rule.always: Protected validation/test, Hard32, and strength holdouts remain closed; generation remains blocked.
